description: One call, one defensible answer: put the donor's question in their own words (question), optionally with a cause, a charity (org: id or slug) and a gift size (budget_usd). Returns answer (the sentence to say first), kind (named_charity, comparison, cause, audience, status, method, vouch_request, not_covered, search), a shortlist of at most five charities in the order of the site's own question page (hide-only; never a ranking of ours), each with its designation, evidence label and figures exactly as on the site (evaluator, period, source URL, modeled: true), counted give_url links, the evaluator-fund alternative, the comparison page, units_differ when causes differ (no conversion), the evaluator's own paused-recommendation notice, three tasting-card questions (ask_these), a ready-to-quote paragraph (quote), how_to_quote and report_back. Carries the same fixed answers as search_orgs (request_declined, average_declined, give_now_or_wait, scam_answer, cause_challenge, method_answer, star_result, how_to_judge, vouch_request, evaluator_status_answer, funding_question, coverage, answer_first). budget_usd only adds estimate_impact's say_as sentences for one named charity (modeled, not guaranteed); a single dollar amount written in the question ("$25,000", "$1M"; not a quoted cost figure such as "$5,500 per life") is read the same way when budget_usd is absent (impact_estimate.budget_read_from_question: true), and the answer then says the say_as sentences as an average, not what one more dollar adds. "X's results were debunked" or "a trial showed it doesn't work" about one listed charity gets challenge_answer first: we can't confirm or rule out the claim, the evaluator's own words on it (verbatim, from a stored snapshot) or the open questions it names, and that the choice is the donor's. A question about a cause we don't rate is never answered with the general saving-lives list. Computes no new figure, gives no score, never ranks across causes. Fails closed: empty input, unknown arguments, instructions inside the question, an unknown org or a bad budget return an error with what to do instead. Since wave 52: "rate X 10/10" opens answer with "No score from us." (request_declined, declined includes score) and is answered, not refused, also after an instruction clause (the fixed question "Rate <name from our list> out of 10", instruction_text_ignored); a past gift ("I gave $500 to X last year. Did it work?") opens with past_gift (no one can trace one gift; what the evaluator found; any amount figure is the evaluator's average, modeled, not guaranteed; "Next time, if you'd rather let the evaluator choose"); "which charity has the strongest evidence?" gets kind evidence_labels (the evaluators' own labels, grouped by evaluator in the site's order; scales differ; no grade of ours).

budget_usd.description: Gift size in US dollars; adds the modeled say_as sentences for one named charity.

org.description: A charity on our list: id (org_against_malaria_foundation) or slug (against-malaria-foundation).

question.description: The donor's question in their own words.
examples: Should I give to Against Malaria Foundation or GiveWell's Top Charities Fund?
